content.title: Prada gets EU approval for Versace acquisition
content.summary: The European Commission said on Tuesday it has given its green light to the acquisition of fashion group Versace by Italy's Prada. Earlier this year Prada struck a $1.38 billion deal to buy smaller rival Versace from Capri Holdings. The European Commission said the deal poses no competition concerns.
